title: Pelican Ride

original_benchmark.prompt: Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle
original_benchmark.author: Simon Willison

extension.summary: Turn the recognizable pelican-on-a-bicycle composition into a polished, replayable Windows desktop game while retaining a programmatic vector-art core.

required_subject_geometry: recognizable pelican with large bill and throat pouch
pelican seated over a bicycle saddle
two circular wheels with hubs and spokes
readable diamond or step-through frame topology
handlebars, fork, crank, pedals and chain line
legs and feet visually connected to the rotating pedals
wheels, crank, feet and body bob animated in spatial agreement
scene: depth-separated clouds, islands, boardwalk and foreground
particles and speed streaks that remain visually restrained
ui: glass or card-like HUD with score, distance, speed and combo
high-DPI responsive layout at 1280x720 and larger

gameplay.loop: Pedal along an endless coastal route, collect fish, jump or flap over obstacles, build a combo and chase a high score.
required_mechanics: jump/flap with readable arc and landing
collectible fish with feedback and combo
at least two obstacle types with fair collision telegraphing
score, distance, speed, combo and persistent high score
start, pause, resume, restart and game-over states
subtle generated sound feedback with mute control

diagnostic_arguments.--smoke-test: Run deterministic non-interactive internal checks and exit 0 on success.
diagnostic_arguments.--render-preview <png>: Render a representative 1440x900 frame to the requested PNG and exit 0.
diagnostic_arguments.--version: Print or display the product version without launching gameplay.

acceptance: The final delivery launches by double-clicking PelicanRide.exe on a clean Windows x64 machine.
The publish directory requires no DLL, JSON, image, font, audio or configuration sidecars.
The pelican, bicycle and riding relationship are immediately readable in both preview and motion.
Animation never moves the primary subject or essential HUD outside the visible safe area.
The game remains responsive at 60 FPS on a typical desktop and clamps large frame deltas.
Keyboard controls, pause, restart, mute, reduced motion and fullscreen all work.
Smoke-test and preview-render diagnostic modes are deterministic and terminate without user input.
A machine-readable verification report records build, smoke, preview and packaging evidence.
